title: Metropolitan Farmers
synopsis: Do you live in a large city but long for the peacefulness of the countryside? In China this problem can be solved by growing your own crops right where you live in the city.

fullText.simplified:
大都市里的农夫

    都市生活节奏快，压力大，人们每天都是在焦虑和烦躁中度过，急需一个安静自由的田园来放松自己，但是要在大都市里享受田园时光，简直是一种奢望。
    在中国的大都市里，屋顶菜园渐渐流行起来了。在不干扰邻居生活也不影响建筑安全的前提下，人们喜欢在屋顶上种一些蔬菜、水果等。有些屋顶上不能种菜的人家，会选择在自己家的阳台上种。西红柿、玉米、西瓜和南瓜这样的比较容易生长的蔬菜和水果是人们喜欢选择的农作物。
    很多人觉得，自己种蔬菜和水果，不但因为没有农药，吃起来放心，而且累的时候上屋顶浇浇水、施施肥，还可以缓解一下焦虑和烦躁的情绪。
fullText.traditional:
大都市裡的農夫

    都市生活節奏快，壓力大，人們每天都是在焦慮和煩躁中度過，急需一個安靜自由的田園來放鬆自己，但是要在大都市裡享受田園時光，簡直是一種奢望。
    在中國的大都市裡，屋頂菜園漸漸流行起來了。在不干擾鄰居生活也不影響建築安全的前提下，人們喜歡在屋頂上種一些蔬菜、水果等。有些屋頂上不能種菜的人家，會選擇在自己家的陽臺上種。西紅柿、玉米、西瓜和南瓜這樣的比較容易生長的蔬菜和水果是人們喜歡選擇的農作物。
    很多人覺得，自己種蔬菜和水果，不但因為沒有農藥，吃起來放心，而且累的時候上屋頂澆澆水、施施肥，還可以緩解一下焦慮和煩躁的情緒。

raw.synopsis: Do you live in a large city but long for the peacefulness of the countryside? In China this problem can be solved by growing your own crops right where you live in the city.
sentence_translations: In large cities the pace of life is fast with a lot of pressure, so people spend their days anxiously on edge.
They desperately need the peace and liberty of the countryside where they can relax, ..
.. but enjoying the countryside in a big city is nothing but a wild wish.
In larger cities in China, roof top gardens have gradually become popular.
Under the premise that it does not disturb neighbors or affect the safety of the building, ..
.. people like to plant vegetables and fruits on the rooftop.
In some houses where you cannot plant vegetables on the roof, you can choose to do it on your balcony instead.
Tomatoes, corn, watermelon, pumpkin, and other easy to grow vegetables and fruits are the most popular crop choices.
A lot of people not only think that vegetables and fruit they sow themselves are safer since they do not use pesticide, ..
.. but also feel that going to the roof to water and fertilize the plants when you're tired is a good way to relieve anxiety.
